title: Fix the verified cubic review findings on PR 1730
request: Watch the pr and autofix (cubic AI review of PR 1730: 45 findings, 29 inline; verify each, fix the real ones, answer the rest on their threads)

criteria.text: Real code findings fixed, each with a test that fails on the old code: History highlight rows keep the score visible with a long team name; pending score card values wrap instead of widening the card; scroll restore saves a scroll made in the 100ms after it ends; the winter theme gets its own success colours (Approve text 3.1:1 -> at least 4.5:1); the History edit hint shows only where it fits on one line (from 1024px)
criteria.evidence: Five real findings fixed, each in its own commit with a test that fails on the old code (every test was run against the old file: failed there, passes now). (1) Winter success colours, commit 0152efc: Approve text on the winter card 3.13:1 -> 8.28:1, season badge 6.54:1, measured in a browser before and after in light, dark and winter. (2) History edit hint from 1024px, d257569: toolbar 108-116px tall with a 2-4 line hint at 700-900px -> 80px, hint on one line from 1024px. (3) History highlight rows, 93b6d34: the number after the name is no longer inside the clamped text; measured at 320, 360, 390, 768px: the number is inside the card on 21 of 21 rows. (4) Pending score card, b40143c: values may shrink and break. (5) Scroll restore, 8a3039e: input listeners stay on during the 100ms pause; all 44 existing tests pass, the new one fails on the old code.

criteria.text: Eight weak tests strengthened as the review asked (long-name member card, career sort buttons, saved-open accordion, long team ID, division row selector, event winners fields, score button payload, calendar day cell); each still passes and fails when its class is removed
criteria.evidence: Eight tests strengthened in commit df267ba (TeamMembershipApprovalTab long names, CareerRankingsMobileView all four sort buttons, SeasonAccordion.animation open season drawn open, TeamEditSection 36-character team ID, DivisionRow both layouts and the selector, EventWinnersEditor h-11 on both fields, ScoreButtonGroup all four payload fields for all four buttons, calendar day cell). All pass. DivisionRow was also run against the old component: 2 failed. No source file changed in that commit.

criteria.text: Docs findings: each claim verified against the code and docs rules; wrong or overclaimed text corrected (footers carry post-commit notes, no implementation detail in rows, no real-phone wording for headless runs); no table row added or removed; link check unchanged
criteria.evidence: Every docs finding was checked against the code and the docs rules by two helpers and by an independent reviewer, and fixed only where true (commits 8a4ddca and 12e5580). Fixed: scroll-on-Back text claims no more than the scripted runs showed (footers carry the numbers and B-14; the rows say scripted, team page not scrolled); technical detail moved into Technical notes; the team tile paragraph agrees with its row; footers name the concrete bug; HIST-13, DASH-18, DASH-19, DASH-20 rewritten in place; past-seasons says in-app link, the closed fallback, the Unknown Team exception, no storage key, hint from 1024px; bell titles wrap only below 640px; checkbox claim names its exception. Not valid or partly valid (reasons given on the threads): cubic overstated HI-02 (the spec describes the non-focusable name, it does not call it intentional). Row counts unchanged in verification/admin 408, foundations 71, home-and-teams 318, standings 396, bug-triage 60 (compared with the PR head eb120c6); link check 2,758 links, 0 broken.

criteria.text: Findings not fixed are answered on their threads with what was traced (team name link and breadcrumb padding, season badge colours, team link slug, DivisionPanel effect) and nothing else changes: six checks pass at the final head and an independent code review approves
criteria.evidence: The five findings left open each carry a reply on their GitHub thread saying what was traced and that the call is the owner's: DivisionPanel effect (React Doctor and cubic), TeamCardGrid link box size, team link slug collision, windowed History list row height, NAV-02 suspected-bug mark (checked on the PR: 6 unresolved threads, each with a reply; later React Doctor repeats of the same DivisionPanel warning carry no new reply). Six checks pass at c053fda (integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit). Independent code review: APPROVE at 08afd77, plus the docs-only wording commit c053fda. Not claimed: a GitHub summary comment failed twice with HTTP 500 and was not retried; DeepSource Test coverage still fails on 5 unreachable lines in TimeslotAssignment.tsx.

reviews.summary: Independent reviewer (fresh, read-only) first said CHANGES at ea471ae: PENDING-20 text was false under 500px, the 512px footer limit left the date on two lines at 768px, a wrong test comment, a vague 'sample date', two needless negative assertions. All five fixed (833d6c4, 08afd77) and the reviewer then said APPROVE at 08afd77: footer sweep of 981 widths from 320 to 1300 in 12 sidebar, scrollbar and date combinations found 0 two-line dates and 0 buttons outside the card; the new tests fail when the matching code is broken; docs numbers checked against code. The last commit c053fda is docs only and makes the reviewer's two optional wording fixes (on a phone held upright; 359 up to about 490 pixels); the reviewer did not re-read that commit. Five unreachable TimeslotAssignment lines (130, 171-173, 210) are dead code, left for a follow-up Doug decides.
